dedupe_keys.name: messageix systems optimisation modelling framework iiasa

description: MESSAGEix is a systems optimisation modelling framework developed by the Energy, Climate, and Environment Program of the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA) since the 1970s. The documentation read on 2026-09-26 describes message_ix as a Python package that ties the framework together, free and open source under the Apache 2.0 licence, supporting any energy system model built on the MESSAGE core equations, with a MACRO formulation for linking to the economy, tutorials, a mathematical specification, reporting tools, an R interface and community discussions. It distinguishes the framework from MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM, the global model instance used in IIASA research and often informally called MESSAGE, which is documented in the separate message_ix_models package. Coverage depends on the model built, from national systems to the global model. The documentation version read was 3.11. Caveats: the IIASA model page refused automated requests on the day, so only the documentation was read, and building a model requires substantial data and optimisation solvers. Simulation uses are least-cost capacity planning and optimisation of energy systems and long-term climate mitigation scenarios. Related records: data-ipcc-ar6-scenarios-database holds scenario results from such models, and model-times-etsap is a comparable optimisation framework.
